overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows clear outperformance in husband-wife relationship and domestic bonding topics (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,770 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,678 views). Pure abstract sad poetry or niche familial videos underperformed, while relatable relationship realities drove high engagement and view counts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए') achieved the highest views on the channel (1,770 and 1,678 views respectively).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on core relationship dynamics, emotional gaps in marriage, and unspoken husband-wife understandings.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as direct relatable questions or provocative relationship thoughts triggered much higher click-throughs than third-person poetic lines.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, direct-address questions about everyday emotional struggles as video titles and hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' (21 views) and sibling-specific videos like 'बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है' (19 views) received very low traction.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract philosophical poetry and narrow niche topics; ground content in universally recognizable domestic and relational moments.
